purpose: Joint head-quality no-prior model inference gallery for MobileCropNet v4.0 master report Section 16.
runtime_contract: no-prior generated proposal runtime; image + target aspect ratio only; teacher labels used for audit metrics and selection scoring

selection_diagnostics.strict_filter: all 6 AR rows must have semantic route match=1, decision_acc=1, hit@0.5=1, target_ar_compatible=1
selection_diagnostics.fill_policy: apply route quotas first; routes with no strict semantic candidate are skipped; remaining slots are filled by highest strict joint-quality score

caveat: This gallery preserves model-inference visualization while avoiding crop-only cherry-picking. It still does not prove deployability; portrait_group has no strict joint-quality representative and the checkpoint fails the subject-box release gate.
